card.name: "Each" or "every time" before a dose
card.fires_on: The word "each" (or "time" after "every") right after a preposition such as with, after, prior to or every, in instructions tied to each dose, meal, infusion or application.

modes.description: "time" completes "every time" in counseling or dispensing instructions.
